title: Covariation of two Itô rows up to a fixed dyadic time
source_anchor: Original Samplinglib supplement: Covariation of two Itô rows up to a fixed dyadic time. Exact assumptions and formula below.
target_statement: Let X and Y be two real Itô rows driven by the same finite-dimensional Brownian motion. Fix a coarse dyadic time τ. The sum of products of the increments of X and Y over fine cells ending at or before τ converges in measure to the time integral of the inner product of their diffusion rows up to τ.
